claim: A deterministic Android `InputMethodService` can provide the closest honest raw IME proof lane for Slate by driving real `InputConnection` text, composition, deletion, and selection-update primitives.
decision: Defer to future proof-lane plan; requires device/emulator/Appium/ADB investment before runtime claims.

claim: Do not expect standard WebDriver actions to prove IME composition.
Real input-event proof needs user/browser interaction; JS-only event dispatch is insufficient.
decision: Keep as support for native event trace and browser route proof.

claim: CDP `Input.imeSetComposition` rows are valuable but Chromium-scoped.
decision: Keep current Playwright/CDP IME rows as scoped proof only.

claim: Appium Unicode/text insertion is not enough to claim native keyboard/IME candidate behavior.
decision: Reject as raw IME proof; allowed only as scoped text-injection smoke.

claim: Appium `performEditorAction` can prove Done/Search action dispatch, not composition lifecycle.
decision: Keep as optional action-key lane, not composition proof.

claim: Use contenteditable catalog as an OS/browser/IME scenario matrix for future raw lane selection.
